div.head: Ine 23
div.ab: Gif mon ælðeodigne ófslea, se cyning ah twegen dæl weres, þriddan dæl sunu oþþe magas.
LXVII. Gif mon elðeodigne ófslea, se cyning ah twædne dǽl weres, þriddan dæl sunu oððe mægas.
Si homo alienigena occidatur, habeat rex duas partes were sue, tertiam partem habeant filii uel parentes sui.
{LXVII} Gif mon elðeodigne ófslea, se cyning ah twædne dǽl weres, þriddan dæl sunu oððe mægas.
If a foreigner is killed, the king gets two parts of the wer, the third goes to the son[s] or kinsmen.
If anyone slays a foreigner the king shall have two-thirds of his wergeld, and his son or relatives one-third.
Wenn jemand einen Ausländer erschlägt, so erhält der König den doppelten [Dritt]theil des Wergeldes, das [übrige] Drittel der Sohn oder die Verwandten.
If someone slays a foreigner, the king receives two [thirds] of the wergeld, the [remaining] third the son or the kinsmen.
